meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可启动本地 Dashboard 查看拆文库、写作项目和编辑文本。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、$story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 说句话即可唤起网文工具箱并打开工作台
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者，想从一句话快速进入写作工具箱。
copy.tagline_en: Route your writing request to the novel toolbox and open the local dashboard.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author wanting a single entry to your writing and editing tools.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会变成网络小说工具箱的入口。碰到模糊请求，它先分析意图，再自动分发到写长篇、拆文、扫榜、去AI味等具体技能，并处理项目状态、多书切换和版本更新检查。
howto.when: 当你输入“/story”等命令，或说出“我想写小说”等意图时触发；请求模糊时先路由再分发。

say.text: 我想写小说，帮我规划一下。
say.note: 它会先问你是长篇还是短篇，再路由到对应写作技能。

say.text: 检查更新，看看工具箱有没有新版本。
say.note: 它会比较当前与最新版本，并询问是否更新。

say.text: 帮我拆解这本书的黄金三章。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude acts as the entry point for a web-novel toolbox. For vague requests, it analyzes intent, routes to specialized skills (long/short writing, book analysis, ranking scans, de-AI styling, etc.), and handles project state, multi-book switching, and version checks.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you type commands like "/story" or say intentions like "I want to write a novel"; vague requests are routed first.

say_en.text: I want to write a novel; help me plan it.
say_en.note: It asks long or short form, then routes.

say_en.text: Check for updates on the toolbox.
say_en.note: It compares versions and asks to update.

say_en.text: Help me analyze the golden three chapters of this book.
